account.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
account.password_signs_out: All other sessions will be signed out.
account.token_once: The token is shown only now. Store it safely.
account.tokens_hint: API tokens have the same rights as your account and do not need a CSRF token.

audit.broken: The hash chain is broken from entry {{id}} on. The log was modified outside the application.

auth.mfa_hint: 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a recovery code

consistency_hint.application: The guest agent froze the file systems at the start of the backup.
consistency_hint.crash: Point-in-time state like after a power loss; journaling file systems recover, databases may need recovery.
consistency_hint.none: Copied while running without freezing; files written during the backup may be inconsistent.
consistency_hint.offline: The guest was not running during the backup.

backup.keep_hint: Same rules as Proxmox Backup Server: each value keeps the newest backup of that many periods; protected backups are never removed. All zero keeps everything.

mode_hint.live: The container keeps running; files changed during the backup may be inconsistent.
mode_hint.stop: A running container is shut down for the backup and started again afterwards (consistent).
mode_hint.suspend: The container is frozen during the backup (crash consistent, no shutdown).

backup.no_store: No backup store is configured. Backup stores are directory or NFS storage pools named “backup” or ending in “-backup” (the installer creates “backup” in /var/lib/hostmanaged-storage/backup).
backup.restore_name_hint: With the original name (and the original deleted) UUID and MAC addresses are kept; otherwise the restored guest gets a new identity.
backup.schedule_delete_text: Schedule “{{name}}” will be deleted. Existing backups are kept.
backup.schedule_hint: Schedules run in the server's time zone. A run missed by more than an hour (e.g. while the server was off) is skipped and recorded in the audit log.
backup.store_hint: Backup stores are storage pools named “backup” or “…-backup”. For protection against host failure put them on separate disks or an NFS share; a store on the same disk as the VMs only protects against mistakes inside the guests.
backup.subtitle: Full backups of VMs and containers on backup stores
backup.vm_offline_hint: The VM is shut off; its disks are copied (offline consistent). Do not start it during the backup.
backup.vm_running_hint: The running VM is backed up with a point-in-time backup job; with the QEMU guest agent the file systems are frozen briefly (application consistent).

ci.apply_hint: Changes are applied at the next VM start (new instance ID).
ci.dns_hint: Empty: from DHCP or the image
ci.enable: Use cloud-init (set up user, SSH keys and network on first boot)
ci.guest_agent: Install QEMU guest agent (needs package sources in the guest)
ci.ipv6_hint: Empty: off; auto: SLAAC/DHCPv6; or CIDR
ci.password_hint: Optional; only a hash is stored. Without a password only SSH login is possible.
ci.password_keep: A password is set; leave empty to keep it.
ci.saved: Cloud-init saved; applies at the next start.

ct.confirm_stop: All processes in “{{name}}” will be killed immediately. Unsaved data is lost.
ct.console_requires_running: The console is only available while the container is running.
ct.delete_text: The container and its filesystem will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ct.image_hint: Images come from the official LXC image server and are GPG-verified by the download template.
ct.saved_restart: Saved. Limits apply from the next start.
ct.unprivileged_hint: Containers are created unprivileged with their own user namespace (root inside the container is an unprivileged user on the host).

errors.agent_unavailable: The node agent is not reachable. Check the hostmanaged-agent service.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.csrf: Session invalid. Please reload the page.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.internal: Internal error. See the service log for details.
errors.last_admin: The last active administrator cannot be removed or demoted.
errors.length_required: The request lacks the file size.
errors.locked: Another operation is already running on this resource.
errors.mfa_expired: The sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many failed sign-ins. Please try again later.
errors.self_delete: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.title: Error
errors.too_large: The file exceeds the upload limit.

mfa.recovery_once: Recovery codes are shown only now. Each code works once if you lose your device. Store them safely.
mfa.reset_text: Two-factor authentication of “{{name}}” is removed and all sessions are ended. Use only for a lost device.
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password) and enter the displayed code.
mfa.text: In addition to the password, every sign-in asks for a time-based code (TOTP). API tokens are not affected.
mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.wrong_code: Wrong code – check the device clock

net.readonly_text: Bridges, VLANs, bonds and firewall rules are shown read-only in this version. Changes to the host network configuration will get a protected workflow with confirmation and automatic rollback and are not enabled yet.

node.no_kvm_tcg: VMs run with software emulation (TCG). This is very slow and only suitable for testing.
node.no_kvm_text: /dev/kvm is missing. Enable Intel VT-x or AMD-V in the BIOS/UEFI. Without KVM, VMs cannot be started.

snap.delete_text: The snapshot is removed; the VM keeps its current state.
snap.disk_only: The VM is off: the snapshot contains the disk state.
snap.not_backup: Snapshots live on the same storage as the VM and are no replacement for backups.
snap.revert_text: The VM returns to this state. All changes since the snapshot are lost.
snap.title: Snapshots
snap.uefi_running: QEMU does not support snapshots of running UEFI VMs. Power the VM off to take a snapshot.
snap.with_memory: The VM is running: the snapshot includes memory and may take a while; the VM pauses briefly.

storage.backends_hint: Supported: directory pools and existing libvirt pools (LVM, ZFS and others) for VM disks. Creating and removing pools from the UI will follow in a later version.
storage.checksum_hint: SHA-256 or SHA-512 from the download page; without a checksum integrity is not verified.
storage.cloud_images_hint: For VMs with cloud-init. The checksum is in the linked list.
storage.delete_volume_text: “{{name}}” will be deleted from pool “{{pool}}”. Volumes used by a VM cannot be deleted.
storage.download_url_hint: http or https. The server fetches the file directly; internal addresses are blocked.

users.delete_text: The user and all their sessions and API tokens will be deleted.
users.reset_signs_out: All sessions of the user will be ended.
users.scope_hint: In this version roles apply to the whole node. Restricting rights to individual VMs or pools is planned.

validation.checksum: SHA-256 (64) or SHA-512 (128 hex characters), optionally prefixed “sha256:”
validation.ci_login: Set an SSH key or a password, otherwise nobody can log in
validation.gateway_needs_ip: A gateway requires a static address
validation.name_taken: This name is already in use
validation.ssh_key: Not a valid OpenSSH public key
validation.tags: Up to 16 comma-separated tags; letters, digits, “.”, “_”, “-”

vm.boot_hint: Devices not listed are not booted. Applies at the next start.
vm.clone_full_hint: All disks are copied; the clone is fully independent.
vm.clone_linked_hint: The clone stores only changes relative to the template. Fast and space-saving; the template cannot be deleted while linked clones exist.
vm.confirm_reset: “{{name}}” will be reset immediately, like pressing the reset button. Unsaved data in the guest is lost.
vm.confirm_stop: “{{name}}” will be powered off immediately, like pulling the plug. Unsaved data in the guest is lost.
vm.console_requires_running: The console is only available while the VM is running.

cpu_mode_hint.host_model: Emulated host model; better for later migration
cpu_mode_hint.host_passthrough: All host CPU features; best performance

vm.delete_disks: Also delete the VM's disks (ISO media are kept)
vm.delete_text: The VM definition will be removed. This cannot be undone.
vm.guest_no_channel: The VM has no guest agent channel.
vm.guest_unavailable: The guest agent does not respond. Install and start qemu-guest-agent in the guest.
vm.hardware_offline_hint: The VM is off; changes apply at the next start.
vm.hotplug_hint: The VM is running: VirtIO and SCSI disks and network cards are added or removed live (the guest must support it). SATA changes and the boot order apply after a restart.
vm.image_hint: Copied as the system disk and grown to the given size.
vm.no_image_hint: Download a cloud image under Storage → pool “local” → Download from URL.
vm.no_iso_hint: Upload ISO files to the “iso” pool under Storage.
vm.remove_disk_delete_data: Delete the volume and all its data
vm.remove_disk_running: Data can only be deleted while the VM is off.
vm.remove_disk_text: The disk is detached from the VM. Without the option below the volume stays in the storage pool.
vm.resize_hint: Currently {{cur}} GiB. Shrinking is not possible. Grow the partition and filesystem inside the guest afterwards.
vm.resources_next_start: The VM is running. The change takes effect at the next start.
vm.sata_no_hotplug: SATA does not support hotplug; applies after a restart.
vm.saved_restart: Saved. Takes effect after the next start.
vm.secure_boot_hint: Secure Boot needs KVM and OVMF with Secure Boot support; TPM needs swtpm.
vm.template_hint: Templates cannot be started and serve as a basis for new VMs. The VM must be powered off.
vm.template_is: This VM is marked as a template and cannot be started.
vm.thin_hint: Created as qcow2 in directory pools (thin provisioning)
